test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What type of ride are women riders allowed to choose under Chandigarh’s 2025 aggregator rules?

options.text: Free rides for the first 5 km

solution:
The correct answer is __**Women-only ride pools**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chandigarh** administration introduced the **Cab Aggregator Rules 2025** to regulate the operations of on-demand transportation services like **Uber** and **Ola** within the **Union Territory**.
 
• A primary focus of the **2025** guidelines is the enhancement of passenger safety, particularly for **women**. Under these rules, women riders are specifically permitted to choose **Women-only ride pools** when opting for shared mobility services. ***Hence, the correct option is Women-only ride pools.***
 
• This feature allows female passengers to ensure that their co-passengers in a "pool" or shared ride are exclusively female, thereby addressing safety concerns and providing a more comfortable commuting experience in **Chandigarh**.
 
• The policy mandates that all **aggregators** must update their **mobile applications** to include this functionality, making it easily accessible to users during the booking process.
 
• The rules were formulated by the **State Transport Authority (STA)** to bring consistency to the operations of bike taxis, auto-rickshaws, and cabs while prioritizing the security of **vulnerable groups**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Safety Infrastructure**: The **2025** rules require every vehicle registered under an aggregator to be equipped with a **GPS-based tracking system** and a functional **Panic Button (SOS)**. These buttons must be integrated with the **Police Control Room (PCR)** and the aggregator's **24x7 control center** to ensure immediate response during emergencies.
 
• **Electric Vehicle (EV) Transition**: In alignment with **Chandigarh’s** goal to become a **Model Solar City** and its specific **Electric Vehicle Policy**, the aggregator rules encourage the shift toward **Zero-Emission Vehicles**. Aggregators are expected to convert a significant portion of their fleet to **EVs** by the year **2030**.
 
• **Driver Regulations**: Drivers must undergo rigorous **background verification** by the **Police** before they are allowed to operate on the platform. The policy also limits the **working hours** of drivers to prevent fatigue-related accidents, typically capping active driving time at **12 hours** in a **24-hour** period.
 
• **Fare Transparency**: The **State Transport Authority** has set a ceiling for **surge pricing** to protect consumers from exorbitant rates during peak hours. Aggregators cannot charge more than the **maximum fare** prescribed by the **Administration** of the **Union Territory**.
 
• **Data Management**: Aggregators are legally bound to store **ride data**, including **route maps** and passenger details, for a minimum period of **one year** to assist in any legal or criminal investigations if required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Grievance Redressal**: The policy makes it mandatory for aggregators to appoint a **Grievance Redressal Officer** based in **India** to handle complaints regarding service quality, behavior, or safety breaches within a stipulated **timeframe**.
 
• **Licensing Fees**: Aggregators must pay a **registration fee** and an **annual security deposit** to the **Transport Department** to maintain their license to operate within the **city**.
 
• **Bike Taxis**: The **2025** rules also provide a legal framework for **Bike Taxis** in **Chandigarh**, emphasizing that they must follow the same safety and **EV** transition guidelines as four-wheeler cabs.
 
• **Compliance**: Failure to adhere to the **Women-only ride pool** provision or other safety mandates can lead to heavy **monetary penalties** or the **cancellation** of the aggregator's license by the **STA**.
